scenes.heading: Start building an email list from day one

sents.d: Start building an email list from day one
Your email list is the one audience no platform can take from you. Start it now.
Social platforms can bury your posts or suspend your account.
Your list stays yours and reaches people directly.
Offer a free checklist or guide in exchange for an email, then send one helpful email a week.
Check each program's rules before adding links, since Amazon bans them in email.

take: Your email list is the audience no platform can take away.
